answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial, committing its share through a polynomial identity commitment. A Semaphore zero-knowledge tree authenticates membership, while an RLN nullifier permits only one message per epoch. Duplicate messaging yields two valid shares for the same nullifier; Shamir secret sharing reconstructs the concealed private key, triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. Gale, pearl, and saffron are public test labels.
